name: Wheelluck AI Powered Popups
author: Wheelluck

sections.description:
Wheelluck is an AI-powered gamification platform that helps businesses engage visitors, collect customer data, and increase conversions through interactive promotions.

Instead of displaying traditional popups that visitors often ignore, Wheelluck turns promotions into engaging experiences that encourage participation and action.

Create campaigns using Spin Wheel, Scratch Card, Slot Machine games, or professionally designed popup templates, then customize every element to match your website and brand.

Wheelluck’s AI-powered trigger technology helps businesses display promotions at the right moment, creating smarter customer experiences and improving campaign performance.

Collect valuable customer information through customizable forms and automatically send collected leads to your favorite marketing platforms, including Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Brevo, and ActiveCampaign.

Whether your goal is growing your email list, generating leads, promoting special offers, or increasing customer engagement, Wheelluck provides the tools needed to turn website visitors into customers.

Key Features

  • AI-Powered Popup Triggers
  • Spin Wheel, Scratch Card, and Slot Machine Promotions
  • Ready-to-Use Templates
  • Full Popup and Campaign Customization
  • Flexible Form Builder
  • Customer Data Collection
  • Email Marketing Integrations
  • Reward and Coupon Management
  • Campaign Scheduling
  • Analytics and Reporting

Create interactive experiences your visitors actually enjoy while building a smarter, more effective marketing system for your business.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the Wheelluck plugin.
  2. Open Wheelluck from your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Sign in or create your Wheelluck account.
  4. Create and activate your first campaign.

That’s it. Your website is ready to start collecting leads with Wheelluck.

Once You’re Set Up, You Can

  • Try different campaign types such as Spin Wheel, Scratch Card, Slot Machine, or ready-made templates.
  • Customize colors, text, rewards, inputs, and popup settings to match your website and brand.
  • Connect Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Brevo, or ActiveCampaign to automatically sync collected customer data.
  • Enable AI-powered triggers to help display promotions at the right moment.
  • Collect emails, names, phone numbers, and other valuable customer information through customizable forms.
  • Monitor campaign performance and collected leads directly from your Wheelluck dashboard.
